subject: dbc_contracts
summary: Reservation::release elevates W4 to checkable DbC at standard density: pre HoldExists, post AvailableStockRestored, post HoldRemoved, with PrincipalAuthorized retained. W3 unauthorized no-mutation posts remain; W1/W2 reserve posts intact; W5 expire stays commented defer. HoldExists/PrincipalAuthorized failures are named via comments (PreconditionError / UnauthorizedError)—not vacuous; OCL text need not spell exception classes. No checkability hole.

findings.detail: lint: ambiguous phrase 'sufficient' in Brief scope text
lint: overlapping touches ['contracts/Reservation.ocl', 'openapi/openapi.yaml', 'src/reservation.ts']; solidsdd-run must serialize these items

UnauthorizedErrorOnRelease and HoldsUnchangedOnUnauthorizedRelease still duplicate holds()@pre equality; Void cannot use oclIsInvalid. Acceptable at standard density—derived tests must assert named UnauthorizedError, not only state equality.

Authorized success posts are unguarded (same pattern as reserve happy-path). Stronger OCL would imply under principal.isAuthorized() and hold@pre present; checkability remains via pre HoldExists / PrincipalAuthorized.

HoldExists violation names PreconditionError in comments only; no explicit no-mutation posts analogous to InsufficientStock. pre HoldExists itself is present—not a missing-precondition hole; optional polish for symmetry with W2/W3 failure posts.
